own_scenes.desc: Desde la emisora pública de la Wayne State University, Alan Oldham (luego DJ T-1000) emitió de madrugada techno, industrial, hip hop, punk o el pop electrónico de Deee-Lite, en el momento en que todos los estilos se copiaban entre sí, y abrió una ventana a lo que el techno estaba provocando en el Reino Unido antes de que llegaran las revistas británicas.

refs.q: Radio shows like Fast Forward, for example, became essential to techno’s support network, helping galvanize interest and plant the seeds of a local scene that had a whole lot of growing to do.
refs.para: The work of Mills and Johnson helped give the techno scene solid beginnings in Detroit. And while adventurous radio programmers would become harder and harder to find as the 1980s rolled on, there were still a few other savvy media entities that “got” techno, recognizing the distinct Detroit sound and its potential. Radio shows like Fast Forward, for example, became essential to techno’s support network, helping galvanize interest and plant the seeds of a local scene that had a whole lot of growing to do.
